decisions.reason: As a small accessory closely tied to the trailer business and service offering, it is still worth keeping, although it remains somewhat more exposed to assortment cleanup than the core trailer lines.
The box car trailer series is a core product family for a medium-sized German trailer maker and, having remained in the range for several years, is very likely to stay.
Car transporter trailers fit the firm's production know-how and customer base well, but their more specialized demand makes them somewhat more vulnerable than the main volume ranges.
The low-bed trailer series supports the firm's positioning as a reliable supplier for varied hauling tasks and is therefore likely to remain part of the portfolio.
